analysis: The supplied units are base_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 2841-3592). The PR changes only documentation: the 'Last updated' date, a paragraph on a Gemma 4 tensor-parallel placement exemption (head 3635-3638), a rename note for TensorParallelSwitchLinear, and about 200 new lines of a Gemma 4 tensor-parallel foundation section (head 4037-4240). The patch excerpt is truncated, and the base units cover only the surrounding text, so the new section body was not visible. I examined the base text against the threat model and found no code, wire, key, attestation or cache-storage control change. The base text restates existing boundaries: owner-authenticated link control, an encrypted authenticated JACCL data plane, fixed local-owner environment with no peer-supplied launch arguments, tenant-partitioned prefix caches (T-041), lane cancellation, and the add-on hold (TB-012). None of these is weakened by the visible diff. A claim that a family is exempt from the 'tensor parallel when the model fits' rule is a placement-policy statement. It is not a security control, and I found no evidence of a changed authorization or attestation path. Open question for integration: the new Gemma 4 TP section (head 4037-4240) was not supplied here. It may describe new cross-rank collectives, prefix-cache tenant partitioning for Gemma TP, media paths or environment forwarding. If it does, check that it keeps the existing invariants: no peer-supplied environment, authenticated data plane, tenant-scoped cache salts, and no new plaintext exposure. Because the main added content was not visible, the conclusion on that section is limited to documentation.
